    Consequences for a sincere directing module #

    Let U be a sincere directing module over a directed algebra.

    • The minimum of the dimension vector is reached at a source or a sink (exists_min_extreme). This replaces the use of homogeneous modules in Bongartz's Lemma 4.
    • The kernel of a cover of any module is, up to a projective syzygy, of projective dimension at most one (isProjSummand_syz). So the global dimension is at most two, and ⟨X, Y⟩ ≥ dim Hom(X, Y) - dim Ext¹(X, Y) (euler_ge).
